node.title: Multiscale Haar norm-product router for crossing windows
node.statement: For split prime rows on a dyadic domain, all valuation-level moment norms share the exact Haar energy sum E_j/2^(j+1)=r-r^2/n. Active levels carry the distinct prime-ideal multiplicities of their odd moment indices, while algebraically zero levels contribute explicit powers of two to every active norm. Weighted AM-GM gives the exact multiscale gate (MH4). For the all-active prize pattern at w=2^37, even p=2^256 is below the required gate, so no official p<2^256 can be excluded by this norm-product certificate; w=2^38 reverses but is already covered by the single-scale ideal theorem. This is a route fence, not an existence claim or shell bound.
